author: Chutong Wang
runtime: ChatGPT web in Safari, not OpenAI API
test_scope: Specialist analytical response tests; no chart tools, company data or business pilot executed.
case_policy: Identical case/source files in both cycles. Version and specialist rules are the treatment. Separate new ChatGPT conversation per case; account personalization/defaults are not controlled.
limitations: One run per case/version; no robustness estimate or repeated-sampling benchmark.
Codex prepares the design and reviews returned results; this is not independent human verification.

Browser rendering/formatting normalized only; source URLs in outputs refer to a supplied source register. Browsing checks were performed by Codex before runs, not claimed as ChatGPT live verification.

runs.runtime: ChatGPT web in Safari, existing default model selection
runs.dispatch_wrapper: Execute the attached prompt packet as the specialist agent. Return the required JSON object only.
runs.collection: Actual ChatGPT response copied through browser UI; JSON parsed and re-indented without semantic changes.
runs.model_identifier: Not independently exposed by the UI; existing default selection retained.
